subject: Urgent: leaking kitchen tap at 12 Smith Street
body:
Hi team,

The kitchen tap at 12 Smith Street is leaking badly and water is starting to pool under the sink. Could someone please take a look soon?

Thanks,
John Smith

subject: No power in unit - 88 Ocean Road
body:

subject: Air conditioner not cooling at 7 King Avenue

subject: Gas smell at 45 Lake Drive
body:
